title: Protocol and Echo
author: Odile Sterling
blurb: Bram Brightwater, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
